evals.name: fresh-folder-with-prefix-and-index
evals.prompt: Organize the documentation folder at /home/diogo/dev/library-docs/claude-code. Apply the full pipeline (Phase 1 through Phase 7) and report the verification verdict. The folder shares a common filename prefix and may contain at least one file with the substring 'index' in its name. Work on a copy at /tmp/eval-claude-code so the original stays intact.
evals.expected_output: All files renamed to nnn-<lowercase>.md (001-117 contiguous). 000-index.md generated with bucket sections and learning path. metadata.json mutated to add original_file_path + organization{}. verify.sh exits 0 with PASS message.

evals.name: mixed-prefix-folder
evals.prompt: Organize /home/diogo/dev/library-docs/crawl4ai. Files use varied category prefixes (core-, api-, advanced-, blog-) so the common-prefix strip should NOT fire. evals.name: idempotent-rerun
evals.prompt: Run organize-docs-skill on /tmp/eval-claude-code-rerun (a copy of /home/diogo/dev/library-docs/claude-code which is ALREADY organized — files already have nnn- prefix and 000-index.md exists). Confirm the skill is idempotent: re-running produces the same valid state without corruption. Report any drift between first and second runs.
evals.expected_output: Second run completes without errors. File count unchanged. Numbering unchanged or only minimally re-shuffled. verify.sh PASS both times. No file lost or duplicated.
